changes.title: How China Keeps Tabs on Foreigners

changes.title: Op-ed: The U.S. lead over China in AI is all but gone
changes.summary: AI debate in recent years has centered on whether the U.S. can develop a strategy capable of preserving an edge over China. The answer isn't looking positive.

changes.title: South China evacuates over 340,000 and cancels flights as region braces for Typhoon Noul
changes.summary: Typhoon Noul is battering southern China and Hong Kong with winds and heavy rain.

changes.title: China evacuates 340,000 people as Typhoon Noul approaches
changes.summary: Authorities have evacuated more than 340,000 people and suspended work and rail services as Typhoon Noul approaches southern China, with flight cancellations announced in Hong Kong.

changes.title: China Has Come Through Trump’s Trade War in a Good Position
changes.summary: Despite threats from President Trump, the overall average weighted tariff on Chinese goods remained about the same, and is now lower than countries like Brazil and Canada.
